test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Under which project has the Government of India issued a tender of Rs. 50,000 crore to build six conventional diesel-electric submarines in July 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Project-75 India__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Project-75 India**__

 __
 
• Under Project-75 India, Government of India has issued a tender of 50,000 crore to build six conventional diesel-electric submarines.
 
• This submarine would be bigger than the under-construction Scorpene-class submarines being built at the **Mazagon Dockyards Limited in Mumbai**.
 
• The tender has been issued for the construction of **six conventional diesel-electric submarine** to** Mazagaon Dockyard limited and Larsen and Toubro**.
 
• The submarines would be equipped with heavy-duty firepower so that the boats will have at least** 12 Land Attack Cruise Missiles**** (LACM) **along with **Anti-Ship cruise missiles** (ASCM).
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Defence minister of India is **shri Rajnath Singh**. 
 
• Larsen and toubro headquarter is situated in **Mumbai**.
